## Skillerr 0.1.4

**Clean installs and uninstalls**
- **Uninstall Skillerr…** in the menu (⋮ menu on Windows and Linux) disconnects Skillerr from Claude Desktop, Claude Code
  and Cursor, gives Claude Code its own web tools back, and removes the app. You can also delete your settings and
  research memory; your notes in `~/Skillerr` stay.
- The Windows uninstaller and `install.sh --uninstall` / `install.ps1 --uninstall` do the same.
- Connections now belong to Skillerr's data. Reinstall after deleting that data and Skillerr removes old connections
  left by an earlier install, instead of showing them as connected. Keep the data and they stay.

**Fixes**
- Built-in AI no longer shows as ready with settings saved for Skillerr Pro, which isn't open yet. It offers a local
  model or your own API key instead.
- The install scripts now always fetch the newest release.

**Install:** `curl -fsSL https://skillerr.com/install.sh | sh` (macOS, Linux) or `irm https://skillerr.com/install.ps1 | iex`
(Windows). Installed copies on Windows, the Linux AppImage and signed Mac builds update themselves.
